title: fix(keyrack): sdk source takes org; repo-sweep tips name --org
description:
## .what

two gaps in the keyrack org allowlist (`org: [a, b]`), found by a repo whose aws accounts live in a
second org. held downstream as a pnpm patch: ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron `patches/rhachet.patch`.

## 1. `keyrack.source` (sdk) has no `org` input

the cli reaches a member org via `--org <member>` on unlock / get / set, and `get --for repo
--org <member>` re-slugs the declared keys under it. but `keyrack.source` →
`sourceAllKeysIntoEnv` spawns `keyrack get` with no `--org`, so an sdk caller (a declastruct wish,
a jest env file) can only ever read the default org's slots.

the failure it forces: the only way for a wish to read `nheuron.prep.AWS_PROFILE` is to overwrite
`ehmpathy.prep.AWS_PROFILE`, which every other ehmpathy repo on the host reads — a cross-repo
credential swap.

**fix** (the downstream patch, 4 lines): add `org?: string` to `sourceAllKeysIntoEnv`'s input and
append `['--org', input.org]` to both spawned arg lists when set. the cli already owns the
allowlist check and the re-slug, so naught else changes.

```ts
keyrack.source({ env: 'prep', owner: 'ehmpath', org: 'nheuron', mode: 'lenient' });
```

## 2. the repo-sweep tips omit `--org`

`rhx keyrack get --for repo --env prep --owner ehmpath --org nheuron` lists each absent key with a
tip like `rhx keyrack set --owner ehmpath --key SES_REGION --env prep --vault <vault>` — no
`--org nheuron`. a human who copies it fills the DEFAULT org's slot, the very slot `--org` exists to
keep apart. the single-key `get --key X --org nheuron` tip does carry `--org`; the sweep does not.

**fix**: the sweep's per-key tip names `--org <member>` whenever the asked org is not `orgs[0]`.

## .also (pnpm patch ergonomics, not a rhachet defect)

rhachet@1.53.0 installs under two peer variants here, so `pnpm patch rhachet@1.53.0` prompts
twice; with no tty it exits 0 and opens naught. noted for any caller that patches rhachet.

## .ask

ship both, with a clamp each (an sdk source under a member org; a sweep tip under a member org).
